settings.wyg_2_body: Custom workout + diet matched to your life — first delivery in 24–48 hours.

settings.gallery_copy: Real clients. Real coaching. Results that last beyond a 30-day challenge.
settings.plans_copy: Same complete coaching on every plan — personal workout + diet, weekly reviews, daily trackers, coach chat, and plan updates. Longer plans simply cost less per month.

settings.plan_1_desc: Full coaching for 1 month. Perfect if you want to experience the system first.
settings.plan_2_desc: Full coaching for 3 months — enough time to build habits with weekly accountability.
settings.plan_3_desc: Full coaching for 6 months. Best balance of results, support, and value.
settings.plan_4_desc: Full coaching for 12 months. Lowest monthly cost, maximum consistency support, and priority check-ins.
settings.league_title: Climb the ladder. Get rewarded for showing up.
settings.league_copy: Included with coaching. Monthly seasons. Top 10% promote. Certificates, trophies, and prize money as you rise.
settings.faq_a_1: You create your account, finish a short assessment with progress photos, and get a personal workout + diet within 24–48 hours. Then you use daily trackers, message your coach, submit weekly check-ins, and receive plan updates based on your real progress.
settings.faq_a_2: Personal workout, personal diet, weekly coach check-ins, daily trackers, coach chat, progress photos/journey, Consistency League, and weekly plan updates. One price — no separate upsell for core coaching.
settings.faq_q_3: Will I get a real coach?
settings.faq_a_3: Yes. A human coach reviews your assessment, check-ins, and progress. Tools help them work faster — they do not replace the coach. You also get direct coach chat inside the app.
settings.faq_a_4: All welcome. Plans are built for gym, home, or mixed setups, matched to your experience level, and diet is customized for vegetarian, vegan, and allergy needs.
settings.faq_a_5: A monthly accountability ladder inside the app. You score points from daily trackers, check-ins, progress photos, and streaks. Top 10% promote each month. Certificates, trophies, and prize money as you rise.
settings.faq_q_6: What if I miss workouts or want to cancel?
settings.faq_a_6: Tell your coach on the next check-in — plans adjust for busy weeks, travel, and missed sessions. To cancel, message us on WhatsApp and we will process it without pressure games.
settings.finale_copy: Personal workout + diet, weekly check-ins, daily trackers, and coach chat — all included.
